model_time_series module

class model_time_series.DatasetHist(file_path, typ='train')

Bases: Dataset

Takes data from pd.DataFrame as produced by IPS_OMNI_make_data where data is stored as a pd.DataFrame with columns=[‘idx’, ‘X…’, ‘y…’] ‘X..’: is of the form “X_{in_clmns}_{i}” in_clmns: is in [‘dist’, ‘hla’, ‘hlo’, ‘gla’, ‘glo’, ‘carr’, ‘v’, ‘er’, ‘sc-indx’, ‘time’, ‘s_spts’, ‘time_trgt’, ‘input’] i: is in range(32) Similarly ‘y..’: is of the form “y_{out_clmns}_{j}” out_clmns: is in [swSpeed_Smth, time] j: is in range(16)

ID: index of data point X: input data np.array of shape (32, 12) y: target data np.array of shape (12, 2)
